decision: Do not replace the serving Gemma model with this unchanged Ministral configuration.
method: Paired 5 previously used official-document pages through the same isolated ASGI API, JPEG preprocessing, OCR, prompts, extraction validation and QA; model order alternates by page. Models use recorded digests, temperature 0, seed 42 and context 8192.

findings.finding: Both models pass the four field checks and two QA checks; Ministral action is hidden for review. This is not a whole-document correctness verdict.

Both pass 3/4 fields and 2/2 QA, but failures differ. Ministral captures issuance restrictions missed by Gemma, while losing the fee card. Direct source-image inspection also shows its nationality-code instruction in action is unsupported; its contact card is a blank Phone No. placeholder. Gemma retains its earlier truncated action and publication-heading location errors.

Gemma passes 4/4 fields and 2/2 QA. Ministral loses the subsidy amount card and refuses the explicit business-applicant exemption question (3/4, 1/2). The relevant exemption is present in its own document-list card.
Both miss the application form in required documents; both retain deadline/postmark and pass both QA checks. Ministral action describes eligibility instead of an action.

Gemma passes 4/4 fields and 2/2 QA. Ministral hides deadline and amount, refuses the conditional extension question, and answers the spouse-eligibility question with the literal metadata string found=true despite returning a relevant quote (2/4, 0/2).

limits: All sources are opened development documents, not unseen evaluation.
Required-span and abstention checks do not measure full semantic accuracy.
The same application prompts are used without model-specific tuning; this does not establish that Ministral cannot improve.
Cold loads, switching and caches affect the recorded per-page times; no general speed claim.
The unchanged app snapshot contains Gemma-specific UI/stage wording even in the isolated Ministral run; metadata and result model tags identify actual inference.
Raw official-document transcripts and source PDF/image files remain local and are not republished.
